claim: Sri Lanka's Ministry of Youth & Sports currently describes Angampora as a traditional martial system combining hand-to-hand combat (angam), indigenous weapons practice (illangam), self-defence, exercise and meditation, while also recording associated ritual traditions.
bounded_by: This is a claim about the present institutional definition and recognized practice. It does not establish legendary antiquity, a continuous unchanged lineage from ancient kings, or the historical efficacy of pressure-point or ritual claims.
notes: Reader use: introduce the art concretely before discussing its contested historical memory.
